descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is an outstanding red-leaved form in the Palmatum Group. The palmate leaves are usually seven lobed and divided almost three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The leaf has a good texture and measures about 7 cm long and 8 cm wide. The ovate-elongate lobes are wide in the center and come to a strong point. The basal lobes are quite small. The edges are finely double serrated. The petioles are reddish and 2-3 cm long. The early spring color as the leaves unfold is almost crimson and soon becomes a very good, deep purple red. The leaf veins are also red and noticeable. Fall colors range into the good crimson shades. This upright cultivar is quite hardy and reaches about 6 m tall at maturity. descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是 Palmatum Group 中非常出色的红叶型。掌状叶通常 7 裂，裂片深达叶基近四分之三。叶质感良好，长约 7 厘米、宽约 8 厘米。裂片呈卵状长椭圆形，中部较宽，先端锐尖。基部裂片很小。叶缘具细密重锯齿。叶柄带红色，长 2 至 3 厘米。早春展叶时颜色近深红色，随后很快转为优良而浓郁的紫红色。叶脉亦为红色，较为显著。秋色为优美的深红色系。该品种株形直立，耐寒性较好，成熟时高约 6 米。其在园林中很有价值，因为红色叶色可良好保持至夏末。其名称大概意为“云丛”。该品种的另一种拼写为 'Murakumo'。也曾被误拼为 'Muraguma'、'Murakama' 和
